steps.content: Milly stares at her former friends, expressionless. At her side stands the master of Euphoria.
Mr. E ignores Sallie. He smiles at Cassian, saying nothing... but death needs no forewarning. The prey always knows.
Cold sweat trickles down Cassian's forehead, over his eyelids, down his cheeks, before finally dripping to the floor, insignificant. But he has to try something.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: ...The situation onboard is dire, sir. Sallie and I were looking for stray guests. We need to ensure their safety.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: It's the job you gave me.
Mr. E watches him, his smile deepening.
He lets the silence draw out, long enough to strangle his prey, before finally speaking in a soft voice, almost polite.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Time is running short. No need to put on an act. Let's have an honest goodbye. I've always known about your little games, Cassian.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Guests, dancers... you've been watching everyone here. Fishing for information, winning people over. You even had the patience to play the loyal servant to my face while selling my secrets behind my back.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: I know you, just as I know every single person on this ship.
Cold sweat soaks Cassian's shirt, clinging it to his skin. He tenses his body, searching for an opening, a chance to strike. But, as if to prove Mr. E's words...

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: I... Ugh!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Cassian!
He tries to activate his ability, but two forces clamp down on his shoulders from either side, forcing him to his knees, then pinning him face-down against the floor.
Sallie tries to run to him, but she's held down by one of Mr. E's eerie minions, unable to move.
These things aren't Sinners; they aren't even human. They are black puppets pulled from some kind of abyss. Cassian feels his unused power being siphoned away, his mind being disrupted.
The sight of his friend's plight quells his fear. Cassian grits his teeth and glares up at the "master" looming over him.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: I know what these are... Underground puppets. You really are one of them... Are you going to use these to kill us all?

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: You fool. This will leave a trail. You don't have time to clean up the scene. They'll find out, they'll investigate. You're in a hurry to get away because they're closing in on you, aren't you?!

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Hiding for so long, doing all your dirty work in the shadows... and you still slip up in the end! Your enemies will find you! Your scheme will fall apart!
Mr. E listens to his rage, watches him struggle, his smile full of appreciation.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: How thoughtful. You always think of everything. If only you were still willing to work for me. Like Milly here. Like you used to. I could give you what you want.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: But unfortunately, your revenge seems to be over. I can no longer help you, nor can I keep you. You won't be bound by this ship anymore... such a shame.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: You never...

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: But don't worry, I won't let the puppets harm anyone. Not just for the reasons you mentioned, but also because...

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: You've all worked for me. You deserve a kinder end.
Mr. E turns around.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Go on, Milly. Make it easier for your friend.
Expressionless, Milly steps forward. Liquid seeps from her fingertips. Where golden honey once flowed, there is now only a corrupted, viscous black ichor.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: ...What are you doing? Stay back! Don't...
Cassian struggles against the puppets' grip, straining to get the words out, but Milly pays him no mind. She comes closer, a smile slowly spreading across her face.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Don't be afraid. Even the deepest suffering can be redeemed by love... Let me take you to them.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Milly! No!!
Her hand cradles Cassian's face, black ooze streaming between her fingers, down his chin, his neck. Cassian's eyes begin to lose focus.

Painful memories buried deep in his heart are dredged up without mercy: the ruthless enemies, his shattered home, sleepless nights torn apart by fear... and the smiling faces of his beloved family, lost again, and again, and again...
The boy covers his face as blood streams down his cheeks. Then, his hands begin to bleed, fingers breaking apart like toy blocks, never to be pieced back together again...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: ...Do you see them?
Milly's smile is gentle, full of pity. She leans close to Cassian's ear.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Everyone you ever loved is long dead. Your parents, your family, your kin... not a single one remains. Only you are still alive.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: There's no one for you to love, and no one to love you back. Your life has lost all possibility of love...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: So what's the point in living?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Wouldn't it be better to die with the ship? To be with your loved ones again. You'd be so much happier.
Her voice is sweet as honey, her smile bright as the sun, but the man in her grasp can no longer perceive it.
Cassian's face is pale, his expression vacant as he mutters incoherent words.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: ...Can I? Can I see them again...?

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Then I...

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Cassian! What's wrong? Wake up!!
Sallie shouts desperately, but Cassian gives no sign of hearing her. She watches helplessly as his eyes turn cloudy and lifeless, as if his heart has been hollowed out.

How could this happen? Didn't Milly's ability just make people lovesick? Didn't she use it just to protect herself? But what she's doing to Cassian is nothing like what she did to the guests. He's tormented... helpless... completely at her mercy. Her power... has it changed?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: This way, there's no trace left behind.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Slowly, slowly... they will sink into their most painful memories. And then, they will turn into monsters.
She looks back at Mr. E with a smile, as if waiting for his praise. He gives her an approving nod. For she has awakened a new power, one that is still growing... She has not disappointed the Sage.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Well done, Milly. Once you've dealt with the rest of them, come back to me. I'll take you to see your lover.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: There's no one worth taking from this ship except you.
Mr. E looks at the dazed Cassian.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: You were kept alive because the ship needed you. Now, the ship is sinking. You should show your gratitude... and give it a proper send-off.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Finish your last job. Disappear cleanly.

He departs, leaving two puppets with Milly. A noise comes from a nearby closet; someone is hiding inside. The puppets drop the now-useless Cassian and gleefully scuttle over, dragging a poor, wailing attendant from his hiding place.
Milly walks over with a beaming smile, stepping over Sallie to get to her new prey. Those horrific screams pierce Sallie's heart, finally awakening her primal fear.
No... I can't die here... not like this! I have to get out of here!

Another blast rocks the ship violently. The lights flicker, and the puppet's grip on her loosens. Seizing the chance, Sallie kicks hard at her captor. Her hands are nearly wrested out of their joints, but she manages to break free.
She scrambles to her feet and lunges toward Cassian, the puppet close at her heels.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...Leave him alone!
Another tremor sends the puppet stumbling. Sallie throws herself to the floor and clutches her friend to her chest.
Seizing her last chance, she kicks over a nearby clothes rack. Dresses and metal poles crash to the floor, creating a momentary barrier. Sallie slaps Cassian hard across his face.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Wake up! You said we were going to escape together!

His cheeks are red from the whacks, but he gives no response. Glancing back, she sees Milly regaining her footing and turning her head toward them. Sallie curses, hoists the dazed Cassian over her shoulder, and dashes for the door.
As one final boom echoes through the ship, they race out of the backstage area and into the chaos of the main hall.
